title: Core proper inverse-system construction
statement: theorem exists_proper_limit_noetherian_core {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] : ∃ (Λ : Type u) (_ : Preorder Λ) (_ : Nonempty Λ) (_ : IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)) (Xs Ss : Λᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (fs : Xs ⟶ Ss) (πX : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj X ⟶ Xs) (πS : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj S ⟶ Ss), Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk X πX)) ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk S πS)) ∧ (∀ (i j : Λᵒᵖ) (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (Xs.map a) ∧ IsAffineHom (Ss.map a)) ∧ (∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, IsProper (fs.app i)) ∧ (∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, LocallyOfFiniteType (specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Ss.obj i)) ∧ QuasiCompact (specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Ss.obj i))) ∧ (∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, πX.app i ≫ fs.app i = f ≫ πS.app i)

proof.text: Use the envelope clause of exists_proper_finitePresentation_closedImmersion_limit to embed X as a closed subscheme i:X → Y, with g:Y → S proper and finitely presented and i followed by g equal to f.

Choose a Noetherian approximation N of S and apply exists_proper_noetherian_stage to g. This gives a proper finite-stage morphism p and a cartesian square H. Over its stage a, form baseChangeDiagram N.D p and baseChangeDiagramπ. Transport the baseChangeCone limit structure along H.isoPullback to obtain a limiting cone with vertex Y. The base diagram is N restricted to Over a, which retains the limiting cone with vertex S.

Apply exists_closed_image_limit_system to i and that base-change diagram. Obtain the diagram Z, closed stage inclusions k, and a limiting cone with vertex X. The components k followed by the pullback projection give the natural transformation to the base diagram.

Use IsFiltered.exists_directed on the opposite of Over a. Whisker both diagrams, their structure maps, and their cones by the resulting initial leftOp functor. Initiality transports both limit structures. Transitions of the source diagram are affine by the closed-image theorem; transitions of the base diagram are affine by N.

The stage maps are proper because a closed immersion followed by the base change of p is proper. Their bases have finite type over Spec Z by the fields of N and the quasi-compactness instance for compact schemes over quasi-separated bases. Finally use the image factorization equation, baseChangeCone_π_app_snd, H.isoPullback_hom_snd, and i followed by g equal to f to prove the cone equations.
